title: A de Sitter Anti-Scrambling Algebra
summary: We study the algebra of observables of a semiclassical observer in de Sitter space. When operators are time-evolved by a scrambling time, out-of-time-ordered correlation functions (OTOCs) receive corrections due to shockwave scattering near the cosmological horizon. When the observer's clock is treated classically, we show that the time advance effect implies the breakdown of the KMS condition for vacuum correlators of matter operators. When the observer's clock is quantized, this implies that the Hartle-Hawking state is not a trace on the resulting crossed-product algebra. We conjecture…
